# Eire Reborn - casus belli that answer a raid. Generated by tools/gen_cb2.py

eir_raid_revenge_cb = {
	group = conquest
	icon = county_conquest_cb
	ai = no

	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }
	interface_priority = 75

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		is_landed = yes
		has_variable = eir_revenge_target
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker = {
			has_variable = eir_revenge_target
			var:eir_revenge_target = scope:defender
		}
	}

	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			is_landless_type_title = no
			neighboring_county_or_viking_conquest_trigger = { CHARACTER = root }
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = eir_raid_revenge_cb_invalidated_desc
	on_invalidated = {}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = minor_prestige_value
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_raid_revenge_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_raid_revenge_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = medium_gold_value
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			remove_variable = eir_revenge_target
			remove_character_modifier = eir_revenge_vow_modifier
		}
		scope:defender = {
			remove_short_term_gold = minor_gold_value
		}
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			change_development_level = -2
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_raid_revenge_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_raid_revenge_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 1
			}
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_loss
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = loser
		}
		on_lost_aggression_war_discontent_loss = yes
	}

	transfer_behavior = transfer
	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "EIR_RAID_REVENGE_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "EIR_RAID_REVENGE_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "EIR_RAID_REVENGE_CB_NAME"

	use_de_jure_wargoal_only = yes
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
}

eir_blood_price_cb = {
	group = subjugation
	icon = make_tributary_cb
	ai = no
	ai_only_against_neighbors = yes

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		is_landed = yes
		has_variable = eir_revenge_target
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker = {
			has_variable = eir_revenge_target
			var:eir_revenge_target = scope:defender
		}
		scope:defender = {
			is_landed = yes
		}
	}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = minor_prestige_value
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		scope:defender = {
			is_landed = no
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = eir_blood_price_cb_invalidated_desc
	on_invalidated = {}

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_blood_price_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_blood_price_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_gold = major_gold_value
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			remove_variable = eir_revenge_target
			remove_character_modifier = eir_revenge_vow_modifier
			add_hook = {
				target = scope:defender
				type = favor_hook
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			remove_short_term_gold = medium_gold_value
			add_prestige = minor_prestige_loss
			add_character_modifier = {
				modifier = eir_owes_cain_modifier
				years = 5
			}
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = medium_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_blood_price_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_blood_price_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 2
			}
			add_prestige = major_prestige_loss
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = loser
		}
		on_lost_aggression_war_discontent_loss = yes
	}

	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "EIR_BLOOD_PRICE_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "EIR_BLOOD_PRICE_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "EIR_BLOOD_PRICE_CB_NAME"
	interface_priority = 57

	ticking_war_score_targets_entire_realm = yes
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
	attacker_ticking_warscore = 0
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_ai_diplo_distance_to_title = 500
}

eir_reclaim_settled_cb = {
	group = conquest
	icon = county_conquest_cb
	ai = no

	combine_into_one = yes
	should_show_war_goal_subview = yes
	mutually_exclusive_titles = { always = yes }
	interface_priority = 76

	attacker_score_from_occupation_scale = 150
	attacker_score_from_battles_scale = 150
	defender_score_from_battles_scale = 150

	allowed_for_character = {
		eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
		is_landed = yes
		NOT = { government_has_flag = government_is_landless_adventurer }
	}

	allowed_for_character_display_regardless = {
		tgp_japan_offensive_wars_ban_trigger = yes
	}

	allowed_against_character = {
		scope:attacker = {
			ALL_FALSE = {
				top_liege = scope:defender.top_liege
				liege = scope:defender
			}
		}
		scope:defender = {
			any_sub_realm_county = {
				has_county_modifier = eir_raider_settlement_modifier
			}
		}
	}

	target_titles = all
	target_title_tier = county
	ignore_effect = change_title_holder

	valid_to_start = {
		scope:target = {
			is_landless_type_title = no
			has_county_modifier = eir_raider_settlement_modifier
		}
	}

	should_invalidate = {
		NOT = {
			any_in_list = {
				list = target_titles
				any_in_de_jure_hierarchy = {
					tier = tier_county
					holder = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:defender
							target_is_liege_or_above = scope:defender
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	on_invalidated_desc = eir_reclaim_settled_cb_invalidated_desc
	on_invalidated = {}

	cost = {
		prestige = {
			value = minor_prestige_value
			multiply = common_cb_prestige_cost_multiplier
		}
	}

	on_declaration = {
		on_declared_war = yes
	}

	on_victory_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			triggered_desc = {
				trigger = { scope:attacker = { is_local_player = yes } }
				desc = eir_reclaim_settled_cb_victory_desc_attacker
			}
			desc = eir_reclaim_settled_cb_victory_desc
		}
	}

	on_victory = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_victory_effect = yes
		create_title_and_vassal_change = {
			type = conquest
			save_scope_as = change
			add_claim_on_loss = yes
		}
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			change_title_holder = {
				holder = scope:attacker
				change = scope:change
			}
		}
		resolve_title_and_vassal_change = scope:change
		every_in_list = {
			list = target_titles
			remove_county_modifier = eir_raider_settlement_modifier
			set_county_culture = scope:attacker.culture
			set_county_faith = scope:attacker.faith
		}
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_gain
			add_piety = minor_piety_gain
		}
		modify_allies_of_participants_fame_values = {
			WINNER = scope:attacker
			FAME_BASE = minor_prestige_value
			IS_RELIGIOUS_WAR = no
			WINNER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
			LOSER_ALLY_FAME_SCALE = 1
		}
		add_truce_attacker_victory_effect = yes
	}

	on_white_peace_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_reclaim_settled_cb_white_peace_desc
		}
	}

	on_white_peace = {
		scope:attacker = {
			add_prestige = {
				value = minor_prestige_value
				multiply = -1.0
			}
		}
		add_truce_white_peace_effect = yes
	}

	on_defeat_desc = {
		first_valid = {
			desc = eir_reclaim_settled_cb_defeat_desc
		}
	}

	on_defeat = {
		add_legitimacy_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:defender = {
			add_prestige_war_defender_effect = {
				PRESTIGE_VALUE = medium_prestige_value
			}
		}
		scope:attacker = {
			pay_short_term_gold_reparations_effect = {
				GOLD_VALUE = 1
			}
			add_prestige = medium_prestige_loss
		}
		add_truce_attacker_defeat_effect = yes
		scope:attacker = {
			save_temporary_scope_as = loser
		}
		on_lost_aggression_war_discontent_loss = yes
	}

	transfer_behavior = transfer
	on_primary_attacker_death = inherit
	on_primary_defender_death = inherit
	attacker_allies_inherit = yes
	defender_allies_inherit = yes

	war_name = "EIR_RECLAIM_SETTLED_WAR_NAME"
	war_name_base = "EIR_RECLAIM_SETTLED_WAR_NAME_BASE"
	cb_name = "EIR_RECLAIM_SETTLED_CB_NAME"

	use_de_jure_wargoal_only = yes
	attacker_wargoal_percentage = 0.8
	max_defender_score_from_occupation = 150
	max_attacker_score_from_occupation = 150
